assign.outcome:
**Pilot landed: reading Figma is the cheapest part of this workflow.** Design 51:1477 was EIGHT layouts behind one node id, all eight built as class strings at [/framework/styles/layouts/wire/](/framework/styles/layouts/wire/) — one new dir, one word in BANDS, and no CSS written at all. 32/32 headless loads clean at 400/1280/1920/3440, scrollWidth === clientWidth everywhere, every layout one column at 400 without being told.

**Cost, measured.** get_metadata gave all 8 layouts for ~4.0k tokens; get_design_context gave ONE for ~2.1k and every byte of its content (Montserrat, #e5e5e5, 50px) is deleted by the reuse rule — 4.2x the price for the same coverage. get_variable_defs returned {} : the file binds no variables. Cheapest sufficient sequence: get_metadata, then ONE get_screenshot at 1400px, then stop. ~5.3k tokens to fully understand a design. Figma was 11% of the 66k spend; priming on the repo was 45%, and that is the part a brief can pay down.

**Sonnet: yes for tiers B/C/E/F, no for D** — the brief must carry the class vocabulary as a list INCLUDING the negative list, the six-already-exist warning, and a mandatory probe script.

**Two vocabulary gaps found.** No word makes a fluid track twice its neighbour (every flexible class sets flex-grow: 1) — two of eight ship an inline flex: 2 1 30em, and the zero-CSS workaround decays 2.00 to 1.17 across the widths, measured. And .tint is a token with no class: it paints nothing, throws nothing, and shipped on eight layouts before a probe caught it.

![](shots/bands-1920.png)

**Left deliberately:** framework.css untouched (both gaps are proposals in questions.md, 7 open); 400/entry.js imported rather than promoted; six of the eight already exist as real layouts, so this is one Reference page and not eight sibling dirs.

**Five decisions for the owner**, each a minute — the biggest is [`.inset`](/framework/ai/2026-08-18/figma/surface-proposal.md), a band-relative surface, measured twice and deliberately **not** shipped.

**Two words added to `framework.css`**, both additive, both one line to revert: `.tint` (a token with no class — it painted nothing and threw nothing) and `--grow`. ⚠ `--grow` needed correcting **twice**, both times caught by minions measuring: the first comment was false (1.58, not 2) and the fix then moved the wrap threshold.

**The workflow is priced and reusable:** `get_metadata` + one screenshot ~5.3k; skip `get_design_context`; reading Figma is 11% of a minion's cost and repo priming is 45%. Sonnet is viable once the brief carries the vocabulary *and its negative list*.

**Left:** eight designs, mostly the oversized `163-61x` tail. Stopped launching at weekly 71% vs ~75% elapsed.
